command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- identities ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
printf '%s\n' '--- root and tree metadata ---'
stat -c '%F|%U|%G|%a|%n' /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y|%u|%g|%m|%p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- content inventory ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- ACLs ---'
if command -v getfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then getfacl -R -p /srv/inventory; else printf '%s\n' 'getfacl unavailable'; fi
